reason: An automation plugin for checking DSH updates, notifying users of available versions, and updating official npm or git-based installations through the settings interface.

summaries.zh: 在设置页检查 DeepSeek Harness 官方更新，并通过 npm 或 Git 源码安装方式执行一键更新与状态提醒。
summaries.en: Checks for official DeepSeek Harness updates and provides one-click updates and status notifications for npm or Git-based installations.

capabilities: Checks DSH installation state and available versions
Queries npm registries and fetches git metadata
Runs constrained npm installation or fast-forward git pull commands
Updates the installed DSH package or source checkout
Displays background update status and navigation notifications
